eventDetail.scope: 2027 IEEE 7th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA 2027) will take place in Shenyang, China, on January 29-31, 2027. ICPECA 2027 seeks to provide a high-level forum for experts, researchers, professionals, innovators and practitioners in the field of Power, Electronics and Computer Applications from industry and academia to present and discuss the wide spectrum of original and novel researches and contributions together.
